integrity: The claimed infinite family follows from a signed-monomial proof and an exact cyclic-gap count; no inference of infinity from finite tests is made. No authorship or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof applies to the specified dimension-three twisted baker map and its nontrivial iterate-fixed points, not all dimensions or maps.
The cited original coding theorem provides one periodic point per non-all-left word.
Exact rational finite checks through period nine are supporting verification, not the all-period proof.
Publication priority is not independently certified; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Linear proliferation of least-expanding periodic orbits in the three-dimensional twisted baker map
